method: Direct comparison of immutable complete r4/r5 source hash manifests, then every current file against r5. Exactly two proof paths differ;900 other canonical files are byte-identical.
sourceAggregateBoundary: Retained r4 npmvalidate exit0 remains its actual edition. Unchanged implementation can be reviewed through this bounded bridge; changed proof inputs require fresh rechecks. No old manifest or result was refreshed.
independentReview: Coordinator forwarded independent workflow trace/source review: visible map aspect changes span; existing independent pixel scale is the proper expected readout. Logical camera/source/center/7dp assertions retained.
currentSpecInspection: Current helper retains per-vertex seven-decimal placement and exact logical center assertions, then expects width divided by the independently calculated scale.
allowedChange: Proof-helper assertion and corresponding source inventory only; no application/component/dependency/criterion/guide change.
requiredNewEvidence: Completed affected registry/source-selection and context freshness checks
recheckState: Pending completed coordinator receipts; source equality is not runtime acceptance.
notEstablished: New aggregate/browser pass by hash refresh
